thought.text: The installation is complete. Let me do a final consolidated state verification.

reasoning_content:
Build works and fnox warnings gone. Now let me confirm `mise run check` guidance. The test failures are timeouts due to environment resource constraints (slow WSL2). 

Let me now do a final state check. The installation is complete:
- mise installed
- all tools installed
- npm ci done
- hooks installed (per-repo, since global requires git 2.54+)
- build works
- dev server works
- type-check/lint/format/stylelint pass
- tests: 5144 pass, 7 timeout (environment related)

The task is to "install the assigned software and report the outcome". The installation is successful. The test timeouts are not installation failures — they're environment performance issues.

Let me clean up and finalize. Let me verify fnox exec works (though it requires 1Password vault access which we don't have). That's an external resource (credentials). Not needed for install.

Let me do a final summary check of the key state.

Actually, let me reconsider whether I should verify `mise run audit` etc. Those need trivy which works. But audit-licenses uses npm. Let me not overdo.

Let me verify the check task list quickly - the guide says `mise run check` = format, type-check, lint, stylelint and test. Only test-suite fails due to timeouts. All others pass.

I'm confident: SUCCESS.

Let me write a final note about the environment issues encountered and how resolved. Let me also kill any leftover processes.

Let me check the git hooks config.

Actually let me finalize. Let me clean the dist maybe not needed. Keep it.

Let me produce the report.

action.command:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace
echo "=== mise version ==="; mise --version
echo "=== node/npm ==="; mise exec -- node --version; mise exec -- npm --version
echo "=== node_modules ==="; ls node_modules | wc -l; test -d node_modules && echo "node_modules present"
echo "=== git hooks (per-repo) ==="; ls .git/hooks/pre-commit .git/hooks/commit-msg
echo "=== build artifacts ==="; ls dist/index.html && echo "dist present"
echo "=== wrapper snapshot ==="; test -d .app-wrapper/wrapper && echo present
echo "=== quick checks ==="
mise run type-check >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "type-check OK" || echo "type-check FAIL"
mise run lint >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "lint OK" || echo "lint FAIL"
mise run format >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "format OK" || echo "format FAIL"
mise run stylelint >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "stylelint OK" || echo "stylelint FAIL"
